message.content:
The cover of Tempo magazine, dated May 31 to June 6, 2021, features a central illustration within a large blue rectangular box styled like a video player. This box includes playback controls—back, play, pause, forward—and a volume slider at the bottom left. Inside, a dark blue silhouette of a person with short hair is shown from the chest up, facing right with their head bowed. An orange rope encircles their neck, tied into a hangman’s noose. This rope extends out of the video player frame, forming a long, curved line across the lower white background.

Above the illustration, the word "TEMPO" is printed in large, grey serif letters. To its right, "50 Tahun!" is written in a smaller, grey cursive font. At the top, two smaller headlines read "ADU KUAT GANJAR VS PUAN" and "LOBI PENGUSAHA UNTUK TAX AMNESTY." Below the illustration, the bold black title "PREDATOR SEKS JAGAT DIGITAL" is followed by three lines of Indonesian text. At the bottom right are price details, a barcode, and a QR code.
